action.content: This image shows a three-dimensional model of a typical L-shaped apartment sofa. The sofa is constructed with soft cushioning on both the seat and backrest sections. The overall design features clean lines and curves, with the L-shape configuration providing additional seating or sleep space on one end, commonly used for small living spaces to create multifunctional furniture. The texture appears to be smooth and uniform, suggesting a high-quality material suitable for such a piece of furniture.
